page.overview:
Who is Acheroraptor?

is an extinct genus of dromaeosaurid theropod dinosaur that lived in modern-day Montana (USA) during the Late Cretaceous period 72.6 million years ago. Its fossils have been found in the famous Hell Creek Formation, home to Tyrannosaurus and another raptor, Dakotaraptor.

Acheroraptor is mentioned in the Jurassic World Dinosaur Field Guide as being a predator of Edmontosaurus, Pachycephalosaurus, and Thescelosaurus. In reality, while it's possible Acheroraptors did infact hunt the latter 2, adult Edmontosaurus would have been too large for even packs of Acheroraptors to take them down.
